rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in calling it full to early hatching and strong A-grade ICM/TE from this single image; zona/collapse features are only loosely described.

Integrates age 40, tubal factor, FSH, low oocyte yield, BMI, sperm parameters, endometrium, and lifestyle well, with appropriate emphasis on age-related aneuploidy as the main limiter despite good morphology.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, linking morphology and patient factors to prognosis; minor issue is somewhat optimistic framing of prognosis from morphology despite limited image certainty.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: single embryo transfer, hydrosalpinx consideration, luteal support, and nuanced discussion of PGT-A. Slight overreach in suggesting progesterone checks as a general recommendation without context.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future cycles, including hydrosalpinx review, luteal support, SET, protocol review, and uterine workup; useful though not highly specific to protocol details.
